title: Header
description: The top bar of a marketing site, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Menu, Drawer, Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: the brand as a link home, the main navigation (plain links, and a Menu for a group of links) and one call to action, with its own loading, empty and error renders for the navigation; responds to its container (@container) — below @md the navigation collapses into a right Drawer opened from a Menu button, the call to action joins the bar from @sm, and the bar gains room at @lg.
